assumptions: SOH is the within-cycle first observed value; telemetry columns are cycle means.
Cycle order follows the source cycle_id, not row order or file order.
Cycle positions are 0-based positions in the observed history, not cycle ids.

comparability_warning: MAE is only directly comparable between models with the same n_scored. PADM-AR and last-delta persistence return no estimate at some origins; n_unavailable_predictions records those failures.
insufficient_sample_statement: There are three independent NMC cells and one of them crosses EOL after 44 pre-EOL cycles. Error bars are correspondingly wide and no VALIDATED status is claimed.
limitations: Only three NMC cells provide a genuine observed EOL crossing.
One NMC cell (B0018) returns above 80% for several cycles after its first crossing; the first-crossing convention is audited separately.
The 80% SOH threshold is a project assumption, not a manufacturer limit.
Cycle ids in the source table are contiguous for these cells, so predicted EOL cycle ids are reported in source-cycle space.
No LFP or Na-ion cell reaches 80% SOH, so no supervised RUL validation is possible for those chemistries.
